footer: Information, not advice. Same output for everyone, at the same moment. Every basket is hashed onchain before anyone sees it and graded in public at 9:45 ET, misses included. Not available to US persons.

feed.title: What the night's news means for sector ETFs
feed.quiet: Quiet night so far. New events appear here the moment they are triaged.
feed.noBasket: No basket: nothing tradeable cleared the rules for this one.
feed.marketOpen: US market open · grading at 9:45 ET
feed.stale: Live updates paused: reconnecting. Prices and the feed on this page may be out of date.

basket.gradeLine: Basket {ret} vs SPY {spy}, after slippage, on executable quotes.
basket.void: Void: {reason}. Voids are listed on the scorecard, never removed.
basket.noAnalogs: No graded analogs yet. They appear as the record grows.
basket.notFound: No published basket with that id. Baskets appear only after they are committed onchain and published to everyone at once.
basket.translated: Machine translation. The English thesis is the one committed onchain.

trade.region: Trade links are not available in your region. The basket, proof and scorecard stay public.
trade.closed: This basket has been graded. Trade links close at grading.
trade.simulated: Simulated token in local mode: no real swap link. Your paper entry was logged if you are signed in.
trade.note: Opens a prefilled USDG swap in your own wallet. You sign; Nightshift Signals never holds funds. Information, not advice.

proof.title: Onchain proof
proof.simulated: Simulated commit (local mode). Not onchain; proves nothing.
proof.congested: published with the signed hash while the chain was congested
proof.verify: Verify: keccak256 of the canonical JSON must equal the hash.

vote.title: Follow or fade?
vote.closes: Voting closes 30 minutes after publish. The crowd is graded exactly like the AI.

scorecard.title: Every basket ever, graded at the open
scorecard.intro: Entry is the executable quote stored at publish. Exit is the token at 9:45 ET. A hit is alpha above zero after slippage. Misses are shown as prominently as wins.
scorecard.recompute: Recompute every grade yourself with scripts/recompute-scorecard.ts.
scorecard.empty: No graded baskets yet. The first scorecard posts at 9:45 ET after the first night of baskets.
scorecard.voids: {n, plural, one {# void} other {# voids}}, listed below
scorecard.alphaChart: Alpha vs SPY per basket, oldest to newest
scorecard.calibration: Calibration: hit rate by confidence bucket
scorecard.crowdLine: On {n} baskets the crowd called: crowd {crowd}, AI {ai}.

league.title: This week's paper leaderboard
league.rules: Paper USDG only. No money and no prizes with monetary value. Positions are graded on your own logged entry quotes against the 9:45 ET exits.
league.empty: No graded paper positions this week yet. Tap a trade button on a basket while signed in to enter.

replay.title: The night of {date}
replay.intro: Scrub from the 16:00 ET close to the 9:45 ET grade: headlines, baskets and how each leg moved.
replay.empty: Nothing to replay for this night.

radar.title: Every token vs off-hours fair value
radar.intro: Gap between the token's price and FV = last close × (1 + β × proxy move). Above 150 bps triggers a drift alert.
radar.empty: No fair values yet. They appear once prices and proxy closes are recorded.

me.signInTitle: Sign in for alerts and tracked positions
me.signInNote: The feed and scorecard stay public. Signing in adds personal triggers and paper P/L, never earlier access.
me.localOnly: Email and wallet sign-in arrive with the embedded-wallet provider. Local mode only for now.
me.triggerHelp: For example: "Ping me on chip export news above severity 3." You confirm the compiled rule before it is saved.
me.triggerPlaceholder: Describe the news you care about
me.liveEmpty: Matches appear here while this page is open.
me.positionsNote: Paper entries logged from the quote shown when you tapped a trade link.

push.notConfigured: Push is not configured on this server.
